name: Rebuild Icon Cache
description: Rebuilds the Windows icon cache to fix missing, outdated, or corrupted icons in File Explorer and on your desktop. This action clears temporary image data so Windows can regenerate fresh thumbnails for apps you use.

description_i18n.en: Rebuilds the Windows icon cache to fix missing, outdated, or corrupted icons in File Explorer and on your desktop. This action clears temporary image data so Windows can regenerate fresh thumbnails for apps you use.
description_i18n.de: Erstellt den Windows-Icon-Cache neu, um fehlende oder beschädigte Symbole im Datei-Explorer und auf dem Desktop zu beheben. Diese Aktion löscht temporäre Bilddaten, damit Windows neue Vorschaün für Ihre Apps erstellen kann.
description_i18n.fr: Reconstruit le cache des icônes Windows pour corriger les icônes manquantes ou corrompues dans l'Explorateur de fichiers et sur votre bureau. Cette action supprime les données d'image temporaires afin que Windows puisse régénérer de nouvelles vignettes.

warnings.title: File Explorer refresh
warnings.message: The File Explorer window may close briefly while temporary icon data is cleared and rebuilt. Your desktop icons will reappear after a moment

warnings.title: Local data cleanup
warnings.message: Cache or temporary data may be removed. Windows or apps may take a moment to rebuild it

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: The script stops the File Explorer process, deletes IconCache.db and iconcache* files in LocalAppData\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer, then restarts Explorer to rebuild the cache
